title: Consent
description: One of the three consent moments occurred, with scope (§9). The three are distinct objects, never collapsed.

moment.description: enrolment: the right to fetch and hold evidence. issuance-confirmation: is the draft record true. disclosure: who may see what, per presentation.

scope.description: What was consented to. For disclosure this names who asked and why — showing the bare QR is itself consent for the non-identifying payload, anything more is explicit and recorded.

captureMethod.description: Voice recording is a valid capture for non-literate workers (§9).

artefactRef.description: Object-store key for a voice recording or signed form. The artefact itself never lives in the database.
